outcome: Fetal cardiac tissue Total antioxidant status (TAS)
Fetal cardiac tissue Total oxidative stress (TOS)
Fetal cardiac tissue Oxidative stress index (OSI)
cohort: The study included 12 female Wistar albino rats, divided into a control group and a study group where gestational diabetes was induced, with outcomes measured in their fetuses.
finding: Fetal cardiac tissues of diabetic rats showed significantly higher TOS and OSI values, lower mitotic index, and damaged cell organization, suggesting that hyperglycemia-induced free oxygen radicals may cause congenital anomalies by disrupting cell homeostasis and adversely affecting mitosis.
